Full reasoning traces for all 195 misclassifications (70 confusion pairs) from the

label. Collapse each pair to browse, or expand to read the model's reasoning. Each trace

a (wrong) final label. This page shows a **representative trace per pair**; the complete
set for every run is linked in [Materials & Sources](#materials-sources).
:::

## `letter` → `memo`

<details class="trace-group" open>

<summary>16 reasoning traces</summary>

<h3 class="trace-file"><code>rvl_cdip__letter__0004.png</code></h3>

<p class="trace-meta"><strong>Expected:</strong> <code>letter</code> | <strong>Predicted:</strong> <code>memo</code></p>

<p class="trace-label">Reasoning</p>

The user wants me to classify a scanned business document into one of 16 categories.
I need to follow a specific scratchpad procedure, checking 1-14 in order.

**Document Analysis:**
- Header: "RJR Interoffice Memorandum"
- Date: "MAR 27 1987" (top right), "March 26, 1987" (next to Subject)
- Subject: "Use of KYDEX(R) For A Waste Tub Stand"
- To: "Mr. Bill Hunt"
- From: "Dr. Rob Harrington"
- Body: Running prose discussing the toxicity of Kydex(R) plastic sheets (polyacrylic-polyvinyl chloride polymer).
- Signature: "Rob" (signed)
- CC: Dr. A. W. Hayes, Dr. R. L. Suber, Dr. Randy Deskin
- Handwritten note at the bottom: "3/30 For the busy start this spd - also for your requested data from Boston withms inelastic Othels for purchase Will" (roughly).

**Pre-scan:**
- Mail-client header block? No. "RJR Interoffice Memorandum", "To:", "From:", "Subject:". This is a memo header, not an email header (From/To/Sent/Subject with email addresses or mail client formatting).
- Masthead/running head? No newspaper/magazine masthead. No journal running head.

**Check 1: file_folder**
- Evidence: Has full body content, header, subject, to/from, prose. Not file_folder.
- Not this check.

**Check 11: CORRESPONDENCE → email, memo, or letter**
- Evidence: "RJR Interoffice Memorandum", "Subject:", "To: Mr. Bill Hunt", "From: Dr. Rob Harrington", "March 26, 1987". Followed by memo-style prose. CC list. Signature.
- This is a memo.
- Stop here.

**Runner-up:** letter. Ruled out because it's an internal interoffice memorandum with TO:/FROM:/SUBJECT: header and no external address/salutation/closing signature.

Final label: memo.

---

<h3 class="trace-file"><code>rvl_cdip__letter__0007.png</code></h3>

<p class="trace-meta"><strong>Expected:</strong> <code>letter</code> | <strong>Predicted:</strong> <code>memo</code></p>

<p class="trace-label">Reasoning</p>

The user wants me to classify a scanned business document into one of 16 categories.
I will follow the scratchpad procedure, checking 1-14 in order.

**Pre-scan:**
- Mail-client header block: None.
- Fax transmission header: None.
- Masthead/running head: None. There's a Bates number "50030 0163" and a logo at the bottom right.

**Check 11: CORRESPONDENCE → email, memo, or letter**
- Evidence: Date: "June 17, 1971", Recipient: "Mr. J. H. Sherrill, Jr.", Subject: "Re: VANTAGE MENTHOL (HRD # 71-0197)", Body: Prose paragraphs, Sender: "Joseph Ottaviani, Marketing Research Department", Initials: "JO;sp"
- This is an internal memo. TO:/FROM: structure is implied by the date, recipient name + internal title, and "Re:" subject line.

**Runner-up:** scientific_report, ruled out because the page has a memo header structure and internal correspondence format.

Final label: memo.

---
